description: qou-i9gk residual, settling Step 28's last surviving positive. The claim was that the colour-weighted p-n bond's departure, tanh(ln q).delta, links it to the electromagnetic sector because tanh(ln q_0) = 0.103963710 is the taxonomy's EM odd-to-even ratio. It does not. (1) CENSUS: 5 of 14 swept q-quantities have that ratio exactly, and `q` ALONE is one of them — every quantum integer is bar-even so [9]_q[10]_q divides out, and the matched number is a property of the bare prefactor with zero electromagnetic content. (2) LEMMA: X = q.B with B bar-even gives the ratio identically for ANY B; and tanh(ln q) IS h/(q+1/q), the ratio of the most basic bar-odd and bar-even quantities, which is exactly how it arises in the p-n departure — so the two 'matching' expressions are one expression written twice. (3) DISCRIMINATOR: the taxonomy documents a bare ratio 0.10396 and a Chern-Simons-dressed 0.10356, differing by 3.9e-3 relative = 54x Step 28's 7.2e-5 residual; the match lands on the BARE value, i.e. the algebraic form rather than the physical coupling. Downgraded: the closed form is kept, the EM link is withdrawn.

assertions.name: the_tanh_ratio_is_generic_and_q_alone_produces_it
assertions.detail: 5 of 12 swept q-quantities have odd-to-even ratio exactly tanh(ln q), and `q` ALONE is one of them. Every quantum integer is bar-even, so [9]_q[10]_q divides out of the taxonomy's coupling entirely: the matched number is a property of the bare prefactor, and the electromagnetic content contributes nothing to it

assertions.name: the_lemma_forces_it_for_any_bar_even_factor
assertions.detail: X = q.B with B bar-even gives (X - Xbar)/(X + Xbar) = tanh(ln q) identically, B cancelling — so the ratio cannot distinguish one such quantity from another. And tanh(ln q) IS h/(q + 1/q), the ratio of the most basic bar-odd and bar-even quantities in the algebra, which is exactly how it arises in the p-n departure (numerator h from the offset, denominator q + 1/q from the averaged eigenvalue). The two expressions are one expression written twice

assertions.name: the_match_lands_on_the_bare_ratio_not_the_dressed_one
assertions.detail: the taxonomy documents tanh(ln q_0) = 0.1039637101 for the BARE coupling and ~0.10356 for the Chern-Simons-dressed one — the physical coupling. They differ by 0.00388318 relative, 54.301x Step 28's residual, so the measurement distinguishes them and lands on the ALGEBRAIC form. A physical EM link should have shown the dressed value

assertions.name: step28_last_positive_is_downgraded
assertions.detail: KEPT: the p-n departure is exactly tanh(ln q).delta + O(delta^2), a closed form, with delta the derived flavour split at CAL-3's order h^3. WITHDRAWN: that this links the p-n bond to the electromagnetic sector. It links it to the bar involution, which every quantity in the algebra is linked to. Step 28 now retains only its first result — the bond rates as derived closed forms — which qou-brng derived independently and more correctly on main

context.axis: qou-i9gk residual: is the tanh(ln q) / EM match a link or a triviality?
context.answer: A triviality, three ways: `q` alone produces the ratio; the lemma forces it for any bar-even factor and tanh(ln q) IS h/(q+1/q); and the match lands on the bare rather than the dressed value.
context.corrects: Step 28's 'the p-n bond sits at the intertwiner point, which is where the taxonomy independently puts the EM sector'.
